data.name: THAILAND IX (TH-IX)
data.notes:
TH-IX (Thailand Internet Exchange) is a major Internet Exchange Point (IXP) in Thailand, providing open and neutral interconnection for ISPs, CDNs, cloud providers, content platforms, and network operators.

With peak traffic exceeding 1 Tbps, TH-IX plays a key role in exchanging domestic and regional Internet traffic, helping networks reduce latency, optimize bandwidth utilization, and improve connectivity for users in Thailand and neighboring markets.
TH-IX connects major networks including AIS, AIS|3BB, TRUE-DTAC, NT, and leading global content and cloud providers, with multiple points of presence across carrier-neutral data centers in Thailand.

Through its growing peering ecosystem and resilient infrastructure, TH-IX supports the continued expansion of Thailand's digital, cloud, and content delivery ecosystem.
